source_message:
feat(g07): Externalize AML thresholds — 12-Factor Factor III

New: compliance_config.yaml
  Single source of truth for all policy values:
  - decision_thresholds: SAR=85, REJECT=70, HOLD=40
  - watchman/yente min_match=0.80
  - jurisdictions: hard_block (11 Cat A), high_risk (6 Cat B)
  - transaction_monitoring: mlr_reporting_threshold_gbp=10000
  - forbidden_patterns: 17 regex red-lines
  - policy: version, jurisdiction, audit_ttl_years
  Override: COMPLIANCE_CONFIG_PATH env var

New: utils/config_loader.py
  Typed loader (lru_cache) with typed getters per value.
  reload_config() clears cache for test isolation.

Modified: verification/compliance_validator.py
  Replaces 7 hardcoded constants with config_loader calls.
  Module-level names preserved — zero changes needed in 6 importers.

Modified: utils/explanation_builder.py
  Removes local threshold copies (85/70/40) → config_loader.

Modified: sanctions_check.py
  WATCHMAN_MIN_MATCH + YENTE_MIN_SCORE → config_loader.

Modified: tx_monitor.py
  _MLR_REPORTING_THRESHOLD_GBP → config_loader.

New: test_config_loader.py — 18 tests (T-01..T-18)
  All 114/114 tests pass.

Closes: GAP-REGISTER G-07 (12-Factor Factor III)
